options.content: Cloud Run platform observations for DEV and PROD, with a two-minute ingestion allowance. Requests and latency use five-minute windows. Empty series means no observed telemetry, not healthy or failed; min-zero workers may be idle. HTTP4xx includes authorization/client rejection, not necessarily a service outage. No latency/error-ratio alert thresholds are introduced. Job completion freshness and notification queue/device delivery are not measured by these charts. Hosting checks are a single Debian vantage, not browser authentication or multi-region availability.

panels.title: PROD canonical Hosting · Debian vantage
panels.description: Read-only canonical shell and matching build-version entry. Explicit unexpected/failed response Down; absent report or older than6min Unknown. No redirect, login or business request. Collector activation required.

targets.root_selector: if .error then error("Monitoring query failed") elif .nextPageToken then error("Hosting response truncated") else [.timeSeries[]?.points[]?]|sort_by(.interval.endTime)|last as $p | (try ($p.interval.endTime|sub("[.][0-9]+Z$";"Z")|fromdateiso8601) catch null) as $t | {time:($p.interval.endTime//(now|todateiso8601)),value:(if $t==null or now-$t>360 or $t>now+120 then 4 elif ($p.value.int64Value|tonumber)==1 then 1 elif ($p.value.int64Value|tonumber)==0 then 0 else 4 end)} end

panels.title: PROD read · requests / 5 min
panels.description: Sum of request counts across revisions. 4xx/client rejection and5xx/server failure are subsets of All; absent subsets remain missing, never fabricated zero.

targets.root_selector: if .error then error("Monitoring query failed") elif .nextPageToken then error("Metric response truncated; shorten range") else [.timeSeries[]? | .points[]? | {time:.interval.endTime,value:((.value.doubleValue // .value.int64Value)|tonumber)}] | sort_by(.time) | .[] end
